Our Process

The Lab Method

Every appointment follows the same exacting sequence — it's the reason our finishes wear so cleanly.

01

Prep & Sterilize

Tools are sterilized to lab-grade standard and nails are cleansed and shaped to your preferred silhouette.

02

Precision Cuticle Work

Our dry e-file technique clears the cuticle line without soaking, keeping nails healthier and primed for lasting wear.

03

Finish & Seal

Gel, hard gel or polish is applied to a completely dry nail and cured for a smooth, chip-resistant finish.

About Us

The Science of Beautiful Nails

AI Nails Lab is a Fort Lauderdale nail studio built around one idea: technique matters as much as style. Every set starts with lab-grade sterilization and a dry, precise cuticle method, then moves through careful shaping, art and finish — engineered for a manicure that looks flawless and wears even better. The same precision now extends to brows, lashes and waxing.

No shortcuts, no over-soaking, no guesswork. Just clean technique, considered products and a steady hand.

Formulated with precision. Finished with polish.

Good to Know

Frequently Asked Questions

A Russian manicure is a dry, waterless technique that uses an electric e-file to gently clear under and around the cuticle for an exceptionally clean, precise nail line. Because no water soak is used, gel is applied to a completely dry nail — which is why the finish tends to last noticeably longer than a standard manicure.

Hard gel (BIAB) is applied and cured in thin, flexible layers that support the natural nail, with a lighter feel and gentler removal than acrylic. We work primarily with hard gel because it's kinder to the natural nail bed over repeated visits.

Most clients see three to four weeks of clean wear without lifting or chipping. Daily cuticle oil and gloves for cleaning help extend that even further.

Yes — every tool is sterilized to a lab-grade standard between every single appointment. It's the whole idea behind "the lab": consistent, hygienic, repeatable results.

You can book any service online in a couple of taps. If your plans change, we simply ask for as much notice as possible so we can offer your slot to another client.

Yes. We offer brow shaping, tinting and lamination, plus lash tinting and lash lift with tint — individually or combined in one visit. Lamination sets brows in a fuller, brushed-up shape, and a lash lift curls your natural lashes with no extensions. See the Services menu above for times and prices.

We offer face and body waxing — from upper lip, chin, nose and ears to full face, arms, legs, underarms, back, chest and stomach, as well as bikini line, deep bikini and Brazilian. The same lab-grade hygiene standards apply to every waxing service.
